COQTEL stores waveforms under State_n/Actionneur_m hierarchy, derives monitoring-record identity from those paths, and relates State_n to EC_time through the official reader example. No frozen v2.1 mapping can express this without a post-inspection code or mapping change.

required_recovery.fix: Add a successor-only hierarchical metadata mapper and freeze its path-template mapping before any new waveform-array access. Re-bind every source used for scoring to successor receipts.
